title: org.openvpi.otter.analysis.F0 Level 1 exports
description: What an F0 analysis contribution declares about itself: the audio format a host must prepare and the knobs the module honors. Read by the host before any provider runs; the syntax belongs to the interface and level, not to a variant.

sampleRate.description: Input sample rate in hertz. The host resamples to this; the module never does.

channelCount.description: Input channel count. More channels than this are averaged down by the module, fewer are refused.

interval.description: Time between adjacent output frames, in seconds.

maxSegmentDuration.description: Longest span accepted in one execution, in seconds. Absent means no limit. The host slices to stay under it.

knobs.description: The knobs this module honors. A knob that is absent is ignored when a caller supplies it.

knob.description: A continuous knob: the range a caller may ask for and the value used when it asks for nothing.
